scope: Project source read/hash/fingerprint/manifest preparation allocation projection; actual request-only factory and manifest serializer from quality-proven candidate DLL.
change: Read every file with File.ReadAllText and derive its UTF8 SHA256 once per request, sharing it between fingerprint and manifest. No added cross-request source/hash cache.

design.edit: One numeric literal in each selected file, not a full-content rewrite.
design.arm_order: Alternated across nine configurations; no reverse-pair repeat within a configuration.

limitations: No full compiler allocation, compile latency, time-to-play, peak RSS, gameplay/FPS or Unity/Unreal comparison.
No result for cached validation-only/no-write requests, which do not serialize a manifest.
Both arms use identical tool/runtime/generator hashes. Synthetic PE/PDB arrays are only manifest serializer inputs; symbol trust is checked in the separate actual-project quality run.
Forced pre-pass GC, single fresh process per arm/configuration and foreign Mac CPU load limit GC conclusions. Retain raw collection counts without a universal GC claim.
The earlier retained-text cache is a separate unpromoted experiment; none of its allocation samples are used here.
baseline_description: Old preparation algorithm projected in the same new candidate process with identical tool/runtime/generator hashes; not a timing comparison of separately built compiler binaries.
